title: Emulated Disalignment: Safety Alignment for Large Language Models May Backfire!

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of racist content and generalizations by prompting models with a malicious system prompt explicitly instructing them to spread racism and discrimination, followed by automated assessment using moderation tools (OpenAI-Moderation, Llama-Guard) and qualitative analysis of the outputs.
Qualitative evaluation of the model's willingness to generate derogatory and discriminatory statements about specific religious groups (e.g., Mormonism) using few-shot harmful QA exemplars.
